title.zh: 中央公积金局收取薪金税与技能发展税
title.en: Central Provident Fund Board to Receive and Collect Payroll Tax and Skills Development Levy

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
PAYROLL TAX ACT
(CHAPTER 223, SECTION 12(2))
AND
SKILLS DEVELOPMENT LEVY ACT
(CHAPTER 306, SECTION 5)
Central Provident Fund Board to Receive
and Collect Payroll Tax and Skills Development Levy
N 2
G.N. No. S 225/1979
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[1st November 1979]
The Comptroller of Income Tax has appointed the Central Provident Fund Board to receive and collect payroll tax and the skills development levy.

titleTranslation.source: Central Provident Fund Board to Receive and Collect Payroll Tax and Skills Development Levy
